name: Cessna T-50 Bobcat
summary: Fabric-and-wood Cessna twin of 1939, the 'Bamboo Bomber' used as a WWII twin-engine trainer and light transport and still flown by vintage owners.

wings: Low, tapered wing with rounded tips
engines: Two small Jacobs radial engines in neat nacelles
fuselage: Slim cabin under a long glazed canopy with many small framed panes

tellTales: Small twin radial taildragger with a single tail fin
Long glazed canopy with many small panes
Slim tapered low wing with small round engines

confusedWith.howToTell: The Beech 18 is larger with twin oval fins; the Bobcat has a single fin.
The AT-6 Texan has one big radial engine in the nose; the Bobcat has an engine on each wing.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
